notes.title: Merry Fishmas! Update 1.2.3 Released
notes.content:
Merry Fishmas! I hope you all have had a wonderful year. To close out the year, I wanted to release a small and festive update. This update fixes some bugs and introduces 3 holiday themed fish to the game. They have a random chance to spawn with the purchase of any fish but will only be available from now until January 5th. Collect them while you can! Don't fret if you miss out though, as long as you have this version of the game installed, they will make a return every year hereafter to spread joy and jingles!

- fixed Pintail Guppy silhouettes not properly unlocking
- fixed Unique Flowerhorn producing Barred Discus instead of Thai Silk Flowerhorn
- fixed positioning of menu Exit text

notes.title: Fishlets Update 1.2.0 released!
notes.content:
Meet 12 new fish breeds and morphs, and add them to 16 additional Hobby tanks in the Fishlets 1.2.0 update!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44769737/f6cc218238a6a5516ce2b6d7577c619d6176e3c1.png[/img]

This update introduces 7 fish breeds and 5 fish morphs. Breed the specific base fish for a chance to acquire the breed or morph. Additionally, 16 new "Hobby" fish tanks have been added and the original 8 tanks are now known as your "Display" tanks. Display tanks earn money and fish can be purchased and bred in them, while fish in Hobby tanks do not earn currency and cannot breed. Fish in a Hobby tank are always happy and are not affected by water parameters or incorrect group sizes.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44769737/498292da48ef96d3fd4ef93e6598eda5a1aa8a04.png[/img]

Along with this update, Fishlets' first paid DLC has arrived! This DLC, named the Natural Decor Pack, adds an assortment of new nature-themed decoration objects. Take a look at the DLC's Steam page for screenshots and more info!


https://store.steampowered.com/app/3142560/Fishlets__Natural_Decor_Pack/


[h2]Major Changes[/h2]
⚠️ [i]Restart Steam if the update doesn't download right away.[/i]

- Added 12 fish Breeds and Morphs obtained from breeding base fish: Telescope Goldfish, Ranchu Goldfish, Pintail Guppy, Delta Guppy, Crowntail Betta, Plakat Betta, Calico Angelfish, Designer Clownfish, Barred Discus, Thai Silk Flowerhorn, Pinto Giant Barb, and Traditional Koi
- Added 16 "Hobby" tanks via the My Tanks menu. The original tanks 1-8 have been renamed to "Display" tanks. Fish from a Display tank can be retired (transferred) to any Hobby tank. Fish in Hobby tanks do not passively earn cash and cannot be bred. Fish do not care about group limits or water parameters in these tanks, and as a result, do not lose happiness (now you can have the Betta sorority of your dreams!).
- Added new paid DLC: Natural Decor Pack. Spruce up your new tanks and provide the new fish breeds with the following 14 natural decor pieces:

- Sparse Bubbler 
- Leaf Litter
- Cholla Wood
- Coconut Cave
- Tree Stump
- Spider Wood
- Bonsai Tree (mossy & cherry blossom)
- Dragon Stone (small, medium, large)
- Large Conch
- Seashells
- Sea Glass

[h2]Added[/h2]
- Added new song "Tranquil Waves"
- (IDLE) Added new Fishpedia sections "Breeds" and "Morphs"
- (IDLE) Added a "Retire" button in fish UI
- (IDLE) Added the ability set custom names for fish, click the Pencil icon in a fish's UI to begin typing. Press Enter key or right click using the mouse to confirm the name
- (IDLE) Added tooltips to fish UI buttons and elements
- (IDLE) Added the ability to set custom names for Idle tanks, click the Pencil icon in the My Tanks menu and type the name, then press Enter or right click using the mouse to confirm the name.
- (IDLE) Added an on/off switch to the AutoFeeder
- (IDLE) Tank upgrades can now be removed. Select the upgrade using Deco mode (default P), then remove it with the delete/sell key (default DEL)
- (IDLE) Tank upgrades, decorations, plants, creatures, and fish names can now be selectively hidden. Click the new Eyeball icon at the bottom left of a tank to hide different categories in the tank. This should make it easier to find and select fish and take more aesthetic screenshots

[h2]Changes[/h2]
- (IDLE) Fish eggs and food are now removed when resetting a tank
- (IDLE) The random name generator icon is now shown as a question mark icon in a fish's UI
- (IDLE) Moved the "My Tanks" button in Idle tanks to the escape Menu (hamburger icon)
- Reworked fish movement, schooling behavior, and species swim speed. Fish that are the same species and prefer schools or a mate will now tend to swim near one another more closely and follow each other. This behavior can be turned off in the Game Options under "Fish Schooling". When schooling is turned off, fish are now more likely to spread out around the tank instead of staying in one spot (such as under the AutoFeeder). Fish are also now more likely to swim in a horizontal direction. 
- (IDLE) Heater upgrade now makes baby fish grow faster
- (IDLE) Filter upgrade now makes fish eggs take less time to hatch
- (IDLE) Filter upgrade now cleans food that has been in the tank for a minute or longer
- Visually revamped "Bare Bottom" substrate to look more... well... like the bare bottom of an aquarium. Fish and critters will show their reflections when passing close to the bare bottom. 

[h2]Fixes[/h2]
- Minor bug fixes

As always, please let us know in the Steam discussions or Discord server if you encounter any crashes or bugs with this latest update, and we hope you enjoy!

notes.title: Fishlets Update 1.1.0 out now!
notes.content:
Treat your fish to some scrumptious new food options in the Fishlets Tasty Treats 1.1.0 content update!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44769737/908f35d20e8057f64efde89917a981aad971bca6.png[/img]

Fish in Idle mode now have diets and preferred food types, and they will actively earn a little cash when they eat certain food types. In addition, a special food type has been added that raises a new fish trait - breeding condition. Fish with a high condition have a massively increased chance of producing top-grade offspring. Visit the new "Supplies" category in the Tank Upgrades menu to check out and purchase the 7 types of fish food!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44769737/db7881e919379cb0be5f0fc7031490821c74bf92.png[/img]

Some other additions and changes have been made alongside this content update, such as moving Critters, a few Adventure improvements, and improvements to Idle Shops. Many of the "Rare" Shop fish have also had rebalancing done to their unlock conditions as it was much too easy to obtain them before. Check out the patch notes below!

[h2]Added:[/h2]
- (IDLE) Added a "Supplies" category button to Tank Upgrades shop
- (IDLE) Added new food types under the "Supplies" category. These upgrades are global and can be used in every tank.
- (IDLE) Added a new fish trait "Condition" which is raised by feeding a certain food type, viewable in a fish's UI
- (IDLE) A fish's condition slowly decreases over time until reaching 0 (if not fed)
- (IDLE) Fish that are in great condition (90%+) have a high chance of producing higher grade offspring
- (IDLE) Added a new fish trait "Diet" which can be viewed in the Fish shop before purchasing a fish
- (IDLE) Added a food toggle button in the tank UI
- (IDLE) Fish that are given their preferred food earn a little extra cash upon eating it
- (IDLE) The AutoFeeder now drops basic food types randomly once they are purchased
- (IDLE) AutoFeeder sprite has been updated to reflect new food types, the sprite also changes as new foods are purchased
- (IDLE) Added a "Move" button to Critter UI, now critters can now be moved between tanks
- (IDLE) Added a checkmark symbol in Shops to tank supplies, tank upgrades, backgrounds, and substrates if they are purchased and active
- (IDLE) Added sound effects when purchasing tank supplies, upgrades, and customization items
- (ADVENTURE) Added alert indicators to tanks showing when there's enough cash to upgrade

[h2]Changes:[/h2]
- (IDLE) Nile Perch is now unlocked after owning the Unique variants of 5 Massive species
- (IDLE) Big Bellied Seahorse is now unlocked after hatching 500 eggs, increased from 100
- (IDLE) Polka-Dot Stingray is now unlocked after owning the Glass variants of 7 Big species
- (IDLE) Laura's Goby is now unlocked after owning the Golden variants of 10 species
- (IDLE) Zebra Pleco is now unlocked after owning the Melanistic and Albino variants of 10 species
- (IDLE) Food will now float or sink depending on the type of food it is
- (IDLE) Food no longer spoils in Idle mode
- (IDLE) Autofeeder will pause dropping food if there are 100+ food particles present in the tank
- (IDLE) Removed the breeding button from secret fish since they cannot reproduce
- (ADVENTURE) Shields from slime balls now take more damage and break quicker as they were a bit too overpowered before
- (ADVENTURE) Newts will stop producing slime balls if there are 20 slime balls present
- Food can now be picked up/cleaned even if it isn't spoiled yet
- Removed music mute button in Main Menu as it's obsolete
- Added some detail to Orange Rili Neocaridina shrimp and Amano shrimp sprites
- Other minor changes

[h2]Fixes:[/h2]
- (IDLE) Fixed a bug that caused all Shop item silhouettes to be rotated by 1 pixel, which caused the silhouettes to look jagged and created half-pixels
- (ADVENTURE) Fixed bottom-feeders in Adventure mode hiding behind deco and plants
- Other minor bug fixes

Please let me know if you encounter any crashes or bugs with this latest update.

notes.title: Ocean Conservation Pack and patch 1.0.2 released!
notes.content:
[h1]World Ocean Day[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44769737/5526868331350d3db4570d765ca3426e7d0a7e0c.jpg[/img]
Fishlets is participating in the World Ocean Day Steam sale that is running from June 8th - 15th. A portion of proceeds from game copies sold during this event will be donated to charity. Consider gifting Fishlets to a family member or friend while helping to benefit the oceans. As an added bonus and to bring more awareness to this sale and conservation efforts, we are also releasing a free DLC!

[h1]Ocean Conservation 2024 Pack[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44769737/7a4cbc85f51394e3585932af07e3af9d1ebbb163.png[/img]
The FREE Ocean Conservation 2024 DLC is here! Add three endangered marine fish and one endangered marine critter to your saltwater tanks. Additionally, this pack comes with a Great Barrier Reef tank background and Great Barrier Reef sand substrate to decorate your reef tanks with! Collect every color variant for the tiny Red Handfish, the cute Chinese Pufferfish, the majestic Giant Manta Ray, and... the slow-moving but cool Sunflower Sea Star! These creatures have a high upfront cost but also have high earnings once placed in your tanks.

[h1][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3006820/Fishlets__Ocean_Conservation_2024_Pack/]DOWNLOAD THE DLC HERE[/url][/h1]

[h2]Patch 1.0.2[/h2]
This patch introduces many changes and fixes to Adventure mode, with a big focus on the Lake level. Many players have shared feedback that the Bacteria enemies can be too difficult to overcome. Additionally, there was no reason to purchase more than one pet/critter (Clam) in this level. When it comes to Adventure levels, my intention is to provide players with a bit of challenge and sense of accomplishment when completing the levels, however the levels should definitely not be overly difficult or rage-inducing. Read the patch notes below and let me know what you think of the improvements! Keep in mind, there are more changes and additions planned. This is just the first round!

Please let me know if you experience any issues or bugs with this latest patch.

[h3]Changes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Ocean Conservation 2024 Pack added
[*] Added support for taking Steam screenshots in-game, now you can take photos of your pretty tank designs and share them! (shoutout to Sbeve in Discussions for mentioning this)
[*] Adventure stage upgrade costs have been reduced:
[list][*] ($5k, $15k, $25k > $5k, $10k, $15k)[/list]
[*] Enemy spawn timers have been tweaked as a result of reduced tank upgrade costs:
[list][*] stages 1: 3 mins > 3 mins
[*] stages 2: 5 mins > 4.5 mins
[*] stages 3: 7 mins > 6 mins[/list]
[*] Upgraded food now fills a fish's hunger meter more, so they stay full for longer
[*] Alert text now displays 15 seconds before enemies attack
[*] Lake level Bacteria enemies will now take damage while cloning, resulting in less clones being spawned overall
[*] Bacteria clones now have a different hue to differentiate them from the original Bacteria
[*] Bacteria clones start off in a brief growth stage when spawned. While growing, their health is very low and they can be destroyed in one click. If they reach max size, they receive half of an original Bacteria's health
[*] Bacteria clones cannot create clones of their own
[*] Clams in Adventure mode now have a much longer cooldown period after distracting enemies. While inactive, "Resting" text will be displayed under the clam
[*] Clams have been given a subtle filtering animation. The animation will not play while a clam is resting
[*] Fish who take damage from an enemy will briefly and quickly swim away from the enemy
[*] Shops have had some additional buttons added and restructuring done to include new DLC content
[*] Fishpedia has had some additional buttons added and restructuring done to include new DLC content
[*] Blue Marlins have had their max speed increased, this means sometimes they will get the zoomies
[*] Changed the thought texts for the various secret fish
[*] Critters can now be sold with the sell key when selected (default DEL)
[/list]

[h3]Bug Fixes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug introduced from previous patch that caused Corydoras to be stuck at the bottom of the tank and unable to travel for food
[*] Fixed a bug with Redfin Wrasse glass variant showing as a glass Neon Tetra
[*] Removed the informational text from clams in Adventure mode as this is meant only for Idle mode
[*] Fixed Albino Zebra Pleco's variant text showing "Toxin" instead of "Albino" in its UI
[*] Fixed a bug with Toxic Algae Clouds instantly killing fish. Fish now take damage over time while in a Toxic Cloud
[*] Other miscellaneous bug fixes
[/list]

notes.title: Demo 0.0.5 - Minor Update
notes.content:
Demo version 0.0.5 is a patch to correct some gameplay aspects, fixed a bug, and changed how fish feeding works. No more annoying "food mode"! As always, if you have any problems or encounter any bugs, please let me know! 

[b]BUGS FIXED[/b]
- fixed a bug that caused fish to earn cash as soon as the tank was entered after game startup

[b]ADVENTURE CHANGES[/b]
- increased starting currency from 100 to 125 to prevent the game from being softlocked in the beginning of a level
- increased time it takes for scales to fade away
- pets, such as snails, now collect scales
- updated Adventure tutorial to reflect changes to feeding fish

[b]SANDBOX CHANGES[/b]
- corydoras now have smoother movements when sifting substrate
- added tooltips to tank upgrades explaining what they do

[b]OTHER CHANGES[/b]
- pressing "F" key now spawns food at the mouse pointer instead of toggling a "food mode"
- also added functionality that enables the "F" key to be held down in order to spawn food in quick succession
- improved upon fish schooling behavior more so that fish are less likely to have odd schooling behaviors, such as preferring the left side of the tank when in very large schools
- fish will also occasionally swim around the tank alone or in smaller schools instead of staying strictly in a very large school
- slowed down movement speed of fish
- added tooltips to various UI elements
